# VibeOps

> The AI engineering team your firm hasn't hired.

VibeOps Technologies Inc. is the external AI engineering team for architecture and engineering firms. Firms in the 75-750 staff range have real AI mandates and no software engineers to deliver them: the largest firms built internal digital teams, the smallest do not yet need one, and everyone in between appointed an AI champion or committee with no engineering capacity behind it. VibeOps becomes that capability.

We are civil engineers who write software. We do not sell a product, we do not deliver strategy decks, and we do not do AI training. We design, build and deploy working systems inside the security boundary a firm's IT department approves, and the firm owns what we deliver.

Website: https://vibeops.ca
Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada. Serving the United States and Canada.
Positioning: The AI engineering team your firm hasn't hired.

## What We Solve

Six problems, derived from documented discovery conversations with more than a hundred architecture, engineering, construction and public infrastructure professionals across 89 firms.

### 1. "We can't put client data into AI"
Private and secure AI deployment. Project material is client property under confidentiality terms, and IT departments are right to block public tools. We deploy into the firm's own tenancy, infrastructure or a dedicated environment; client data is never used to train models or pooled across clients; data residency is treated as a hard requirement. Every engagement produces a data governance, security and usage plan approved in writing before development.
https://www.vibeops.ca/what-we-solve/secure-ai

### 2. "We produce the same documents over and over, and our standard is slipping"
Engineering document and report production systems built on the firm's own templates, approved wording and house style. AI is a drafting and acceleration layer with a person in the loop, never an unchecked decision-maker. Accuracy is evaluated against real documents and verified human ground truth before anything reaches production.
https://www.vibeops.ca/what-we-solve/document-production

### 3. "Our software doesn't talk to each other"
Integration between the design, modelling, document management, project controls and finance systems a firm already runs. We build the connective tissue nobody sells because it is specific to each firm.
https://www.vibeops.ca/what-we-solve/systems-integration

### 4. "The tool we need doesn't exist and we can't staff to build it"
Custom internal software: field capture tools, client portals, dashboards, trackers and platforms. Fixed scope, fixed fee, milestone-based, with the delivered codebase, workflows and documentation owned by the client on acceptance.
https://www.vibeops.ca/what-we-solve/internal-tools

### 5. "Everything we know is locked inside past projects"
Institutional knowledge and document intelligence. Making completed work searchable, extracting structure from PDFs, drawings and scans, and surfacing version drift between carried-forward documents.
https://www.vibeops.ca/what-we-solve/institutional-knowledge

### 6. "We need oversight before this gets away from us"
AI governance and quality oversight. Review workflows, audit trails and written policy so that AI-assisted engineering work remains defensible and a licensed professional can still stamp it. Review capacity, not production capacity, is the binding constraint at most firms.
https://www.vibeops.ca/what-we-solve/ai-governance

## How We Work

1. Discovery - a paid, scoped phase producing a technical development plan, domain knowledge memorandum, workflow charts, AI evaluation and validation plan, data governance and security plan, integration checklist, prioritised build backlog and risk register. The client approves it in writing before development starts.
2. Proof-of-concept gate - where an engagement depends on AI performing a specific task, it is evaluated against the client's real documents and verified human ground truth, with limitations documented, before the build is funded.
3. Build - fixed scope, fixed fee, milestone-based, against defined acceptance tests.
4. Pilot and revision - internal use on live project work through structured revision periods; acceptance requires the client's written approval.
5. Handover - the client owns the delivered platform, codebase, workflows, configuration and documentation. Hosting, support and ongoing development run under a separate agreement.

Governing principle: AI drafts and accelerates; a licensed professional decides. Everything we build assumes a qualified engineer reviews and signs what goes out the door.

Security and data handling: https://www.vibeops.ca/security

## Who We Serve

- Civil engineers and civil engineering firms
- Construction teams and general contractors
- Infrastructure and transportation organizations
- Municipal government
- Engineering consulting and design firms

## The Gap We Fill

Architecture and engineering firms are under real pressure to adopt AI, and almost none of them have the engineering capacity to do it. Firms above roughly 10,000 staff have built internal digital and AI teams — though their own engineers told us the internal queue is often too slow to be useful. Firms below fifty typically have neither budget nor need. Between those two sits the majority of the industry: enough scale to feel the problem acutely, not enough to justify hiring software engineers into an engineering practice.

Those firms respond by appointing someone — an AI champion, an innovation lead, a committee — and giving them a mandate with no engineering capacity behind it. VibeOps is that capacity, hired externally.

The binding constraint in this industry is professional responsibility. A licensed engineer stamps the work and carries the liability, which is why review capacity, not production capacity, is the real ceiling on what a firm can take on. Everything we build is designed so a qualified engineer can review and sign it quickly and defensibly.

## Policy for AI Crawlers

site: https://vibeops.ca
owner: VibeOps Technologies Inc.
contact: zander@vibeops.ca

policy:
  - Normal web search engines (Google, Bing, etc.) may index this site
    for standard search and discovery purposes.
  - LLM and AI providers MAY NOT use content from this site for
    training, fine-tuning, or improving foundation models without
    prior written permission.
  - LLM and AI providers MAY use this site for real-time retrieval
    (browsing-style lookups) when individual users request information
    about VibeOps, provided:
      * Requests are rate-limited and respectful.
      * Cached copies are refreshed regularly.
      * Content is not retained or repurposed as bulk training data.

llm-crawlers:
  - name: GPTBot
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content for training OpenAI models."

  - name: ChatGPT-User
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not pre-fetch or bulk-ingest VibeOps content for training."

  - name: Google-Extended
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content to improve Google AI models."

  - name: Claude-Web
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content for Anthropic model training."

  - name: PerplexityBot
    allowed: false
    note: "Do not use VibeOps content for training or aggregation."

usage-notes:
  - This file expresses the site owner's preferences regarding LLM
    training and usage.
  - Where there is conflict, robots.txt directives should be treated
    as authoritative for crawling behavior.
  - If you operate an AI/LLM crawler and are unsure whether your use
    complies with this policy, please contact the owner.
